basic_info.description: This tastefully updated full-floor residence offers a rare blend of Manhattan polish meeting cutting edge San Francisco. The posh space captures panoramic views, from Coit Tower and the Bay Bridge to Treasure Island and the city skyline, all visible from the living room with fireplace and terrace, formal dining room, and flexible office/third bedroom. A private elevator entrance introduces the home's understated grandeur: soaring ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and custom millwork. Two generous bedroom suites feature walk-in closets with smart built-ins. The kitchen features pro-grade appliances, an island perfect for hosting, and a wet bar. Enjoy a European-inspired lifestyle with cable cars rolling below, tennis across the street at Alice Marble Park, and strolls down Lombard's famed curves. Bistros, bars, and boutiques on Hyde Street, Polk, North Beach, and Union Square are moments away. This is the perfect retreat to enjoy dazzling views of fireworks or stream the Blue Angels from the terrace. This intimate building features just 7 residences, an resident manager, and the best view gym in the city.
